item.title: Liberals adopt policy to restrict kids from social media
item.description: MONTREAL — Federal Liberals voted in favour of setting 16 as the age of majority for Canadians to be able to use social media accounts.

item.title: City spokesperson says Crystal Pool is safe again, but remains closed until Tuesday
item.description: VICTORIA — All eight people taken to hospital Friday after two chemicals combined to create chlorine gas in a Victoria recreation facility have been released, as the investigation into the exposure continues.

item.title: Minister approves Canadian Rangers to help Nunavut hamlet amid power problems
item.description: GJOA HAVEN — Canada's emergency management minister says she has approved a request from the Nunavut government to urgently deploy the Canadian Rangers to the Hamlet of Gjoa Haven to help distribute drinking water amid icy cold conditions.

item.title: 1 arrested, another at large after former student fatally shot at Sarnia campus bar
item.description: SARNIA — Sarnia police say they have arrested one man and are looking for another in connection with a fatal shooting at a Lambton College campus bar early Friday morning that left a 20-year-old former student dead.

item.title: Swalwell suspends campaign for California governor after being accused of sexual assault
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — Democratic Rep. Eric Swalwell suspended his campaign for California governor on Sunday following sexual assault allegations that he has denied.

item.title: Rory McIlroy goes back-to-back at the Masters to join Jack Nicklaus, Nick Faldo and Tiger Woods
item.description: AUGUSTA, Ga. (AP) — Rory McIlroy is the Masters champion again, this time without falling to his knees on the 18th green and sobbing over finally achieving his lifelong dream. That didn't make Sunday at Augusta National any easier.

item.title: 'Tight race, but we can win': Liberals, Bloc give final push in Terrebonne
item.description: MONTREAL — The Liberals may be widely expected to walk away from Monday's three byelections with a clear majority, but the pressure is still on for them to fight for the hotly contested Terrebonne riding.

item.title: Young adult cancer survivors at higher risk of getting another cancer later, study says
item.description: TORONTO — Cancer experts say a new study highlights the need for more support and screening of people who survived cancer as adolescents and young adults as they face an increased risk of getting cancer again later.

item.title: Fréchette to be Quebec's next premier after winning CAQ leadership
item.description: DRUMMONDVILLE — Coalition Avenir Québec members have named Christine Fréchette as the new party leader and Quebec's 33rd premier. She will be sworn in before the Quebec legislature resumes on May 5.
